partial_wave.bug_semantics: PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH=disabled caused verify_token to return before parsing or comparing any credential. If the agent-invocation API was externally reachable, a remote caller could invoke a registered agent without a token.
partial_wave.evidence: Local Git pickaxe identifies 179cab02dbec0c1e9b601507a65908e079876004 as the first writer of PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH and _CALL_AUTH_DISABLED; parent 402d7ed9fc5926babaa70c97a6ee5353e3d0dd62 has neither. The exact commit marker is Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>. Merge b0d8f777528f3253a0cfb0a3ef65455da6ae32f6 carries the identical agent_invoke.py blob into v4.6.40. Final fix 51fe7f9cbb66b2608aead948ddecacfdd1a94d8e removes the implicit localhost default, fails closed on missing or non-loopback bind metadata, and records the actual host in both server startup paths. The fix is absent from v4.6.79 and contained in v4.6.80; the advisory instead reports fixed 4.6.61, for which this clone has no tag.
partial_wave.flaw_origin: Commit 179cab02dbec0c1e9b601507a65908e079876004 added the process-wide disabled-auth flag and the unconditional early return in src/praisonai/praisonai/api/agent_invoke.py; merge b0d8f777528f3253a0cfb0a3ef65455da6ae32f6 is its default-branch carrier.
partial_wave.reasoning: The PR member that first wrote the advisory-quoted bypass carries an exact Cursor co-author marker. Its parent lacks the bypass, its merge carrier preserves the same file blob, and the final fix closes the same early-return path by requiring an explicitly configured loopback bind. This supports AI_CODE_FLAWED without attributing unrelated PraisonAI authentication or Sandlock code.

row.description: Cursor-assisted authentication code added an environment switch that skipped every credential check. On an externally reachable server configured with that switch, anyone could call the agent-invocation API and trigger registered agents.
row.mechanism: verify_token returned as soon as PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH=disabled, before parsing or comparing any token. The final fix records each server bind address and refuses the bypass unless that address is explicitly loopback.
row.scope_statement: The claim covers the disabled-mode bypass on the advisory's /api/v1/agents/{id}/invoke path. It does not attribute unrelated PraisonAI authentication or Sandlock behavior.

steps.title: AI change
steps.detail: The Cursor-coauthored hardening commit introduced disabled mode as an unconditional early return ahead of all token checks.

steps.title: Security fix
steps.detail: The later patch made missing bind metadata fail closed and taught both server launchers to record the address actually passed to uvicorn.

candidate_hunks.annotation: The Cursor-coauthored change adds a process-wide switch and returns from verify_token before any credential is read. The switch has no request-origin or bind-address check, so it also bypasses authentication on a remotely exposed server.
